meta.name: baoyu-electron-extract
meta.description: Extracts resources and JavaScript from any installed Electron app (`.asar` bundle), restoring original sources from `.js.map` files when available or formatting minified code with Prettier otherwise. Use when user wants to "extract Electron app", "decompile Electron", "get the source code of <app>", "inspect app.asar", "看 Electron 应用源码", "提取 .asar", or asks how a desktop Electron app is built. Skips `node_modules` and supports both macOS and Windows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提取 Electron 应用的源码和资源
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想查看或分析某个 Electron 桌面应用的内部实现
copy.tagline_en: Extract source code and resources from Electron apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to inspect or analyze the internals of an Electron desktop app

howto.what: 你给出应用名或路径后,它调用脚本拆开该 Electron 应用的 app.asar,导出其中的资源与 JS;有 .js.map 就还原原始源码,没有就用 Prettier 排版,并跳过 node_modules。
howto.when: 当你要求提取、反编译 Electron 应用,或想看某个桌面应用(如 Codex、Cursor、VS Code 等)的源码、检查 app.asar 时触发;也可直接给应用名或绝对路径。

say.text: 帮我提取 Codex 这个 Electron 应用的源码
say.note: 脚本拆 app.asar,结果写到下载目录

say.text: 先用 --dry-run 预览 Codex 会解析到哪个 .asar 路径
say.note: 只打印解析结果,不写文件

howto.what_en: Give an app name or path and it unpacks that Electron app's app.asar, exporting resources and JS. A .js.map restores original sources; otherwise minified code is Prettier-formatted. node_modules is skipped.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to extract or decompile an Electron app, view the source of a desktop app such as Codex, Cursor or VS Code, or inspect app.asar; an app name or absolute path also works.

say_en.text: Extract the source code of the Electron app Codex
say_en.note: Runs the script and writes output to ~/Downloads.

say_en.text: Unpack /Applications/Visual Studio Code.app and show me its code
say_en.note: Uses the absolute path to find app.asar.

say_en.text: Preview with --dry-run to see which .asar Codex resolves to
say_en.note: Prints resolved paths without writing files.
